messages:
micah: Heads-up: minor agenda flip before kickoff. Demo moves to 10:03, live Q&A to 10:17. I'll post a sticky in #lobby. Also heard a tiny mic pop in rehearsal  can AV check?

tara-av: On it. Found a loose XLR on presenter mic, tightened and tested. Still seeing a 1s slide-camera desync when presenter alt-tabs. Recommend single laptop for demo.

anya: I'll post the sticky and pin seeded leadership prompts (roadmap priorities, Dedicated rollout timeline) in the Q&A thread for upvotes.

sam: Caption service warm-restarted. Latency ~1.3s; if captions drop we'll post transcript within 4 hours.

micah: Jen, can you be ready for SLA/timeline clarifications during the first 3 min of Q&A?

jen: Yep, I'll hop into the Q&A segment. No SLA wording changes planned today.

stream-bot: Stream monitor: ingest latency 0.35s, packet loss 0.02% over 5m. Failover triggers at 5% loss or >5s sustained gap.

tara-av: Fallback plan for ops: 1) try encoder restart 2) if jitter >250ms for 30s switch to slides-only 3) if OBS exits, rehost to backup ingest (ops command pinned).

anya: Sticky posted: "Agenda tweak: demo 10:03, Q&A 10:17. Upvote questions in thread. We may pause video briefly for audio fixes; captions ON when available."

micah: If anyone needs last-sec slide edits DM tara-av with `slide:<num>`. After the meeting I'll post Q&A follow-ups and clips. See you on stage.

tara-av: Audio stable at -6dB. Switching to program layout in 40s. Good luck! :thumbsup:
